enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn over to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn over to right side. Stretch legs. Turn over again. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up in bed. Sit up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan and place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Add milk. Stir. Toast bread. Put eggs and bread on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out work bag. Pack laptop. Pack stethoscope. Pack ID badge. Pack water bottle. Pack lunch. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull stop request cord. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient list. Review charts on computer. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vitals. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Update chart. Take break. Drink water. Eat lunch. Complete paperwork. End shift.

Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull stop request cord. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat, and rice. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Put food on plate.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher. Pick up glass. Rinse glass. Put glass in dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing into casual clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on casual clothes. Turn off bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select a show. Put down remote. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Take out snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to check messages and unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at computer desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email. Read messages. Reply to messages. Open social media. Scroll. Close social media. Open video. Watch video. Close video. Open browser. Read news. Shut down computer. Stand up. Turn off living room light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Adjust pillow. Sit up. Read more. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn over to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn over to right side. Stretch legs. Turn over again. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep.
